_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). The 'Switch&Roll' stroller-roll configuration of the modular Veer Switchback system. Single by default, expandable to double with a Second Seat Adapter Kit. Shares its car-seat adapter with veer-switchback-jog (adapter-veer-switchback). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Veer Switch&Roll (Switchback System stroller, single or double)

clekListed.clekRow: Veer — Switchback & Roll (Single or Double) — Switchback Infant Car Seat Adapter – Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna — Second-seat adapter kit required for double mode

specs._weightNote: Frame only 20.25 lb; frame + Switchback Seat 27.75 lb.
specs._dimsNote: Open 44 x 25.5 x 40 in (max handle height 44 in). Folded with seat 15 x 25.5 x 36 in; folded without seat 11 x 25.5 x 33 in.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 0+ years with Infant Insert (or infant car seat + adapter)

specs._capacityNote: Rear seat 50 lb; front seat (added in double mode via adapter) 40 lb. Default single seat; seatCount reflects single config. Max child height not published by Veer.

safety.standards: Meets or exceeds ASTM (16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833) and EN 1888.2 safety standards
safety.notes: 5-point safety harness; near lay-flat recline suitable with infant insert.

specs.foldType: one-hand fold (seat on or off); folds to 11 in deep without seat
specs.recline: single-handed one-click 4-position recline including near lay-flat
specs.tires: XL never-flat (foam-filled) tires; front wheel 9.5 in / rear wheel 12 in; swivel front for strolling

notes: Stroller-roll configuration of the modular Veer Switchback system; smaller swivel front wheel + never-flat tires (vs the &Jog's fixed front + pneumatic tires). Ships single; DOUBLE mode requires a separate Second Seat Adapter Kit (front seat rated 40 lb). Uses the Switchback Infant Car Seat Adapter (adapter-veer-switchback), the SAME adapter as veer-switchback-jog; running two infant car seats in double mode requires two adapters plus the Second Seat Adapter Kit. Adapter (Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna) explicitly lists the Clek Liing. $949 DTC and at Buttercup (limited stock).
